# `.vscode/`

**What it is.** Editor settings for Visual Studio Code.

**Purpose in the repository.** `tasks.json` defines the configure, Release build and CTest tasks (using the `build/` directory and the default build task); `settings.json` holds workspace editor settings. It affects only how the author edits the repository, not any result.

**Files directly in this folder:** 2 (besides this README).  
Repository-wide status of every file: [`LEGACY_MAP.md`](../LEGACY_MAP.md).
